step1.title: Phendula
step1.body: Chitha imizuzu eyishumi noMandi. Imibuzo emihle eyamashumi amahlanu nesithupha mayelana nokuthi uzizwa kanjani — ngolimi lwakho.

step2.title: Thunga ingubo yakho
step2.body: Impendulo ngayinye iyisitebhe. Ndawonye ziba yiMandi Blanket yakho — imephu ebonakalayo yalapho ukhona.

step3.title: Thola uhlelo lwakho
step3.body: Izindatshana, izinsiza, nodokotela abakhuluma ulimi lwakho — kwenziwe ngokwalokho okwabelene nathi.

peek.title: Yakhiwe ngezimpendulo zakho.
peek.caption: Lokhu kuyikhonkco lokuqedwa — isitebhe ngasinye siyingxenye yendaba yakho.

read.title: Iqiniso Nge-HRT
read.body: Imfundo elula. Iminyaka engamashumi amabili nantathu yokungaqondi, kulungisiwe.

find.title: Thola udokotela
find.body: Odokotela abafundisiwe nge-HRT abakhuluma ulimi lwakho — kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika.

gather.title: Imicimbi yaMandi
gather.body: Imibukiso, ii-Q&A, neeMandi Cafés. I-menopause yayiyimfihlo — lokhu kuyahlanganisa.

honour.title: Hlonipha Omama
honour.body: Inkonzo ephilayo. Abesifazane imizimba yabo eyabumba imithi esinayo namuhla.

built.line1: Iphrojekthi yeMrsKing Productions, esungulwe nguHermi King.
built.line2: Iseluleko sezempilo sivela kuDr Funeka Bango.
built.line3: Iqaliswa kanye nedokhumentari yekykNET ethi Meer as Warm Gloede ngo-Agasti 2026.

consent.title: Ngaphambi kokuba siqale — izinto ezimbalwa okufanele uzazi.
consent.body: Imibuzo elandelayo iphathelene nempilo yakho nokuzizwa kwakho. Sisebenzisa izimpendulo zakho kuphela ukukunikeza indlela yakho yomuntu siqu. Asithengisi ulwazi lwakho. Asiklabelani nakubani ngaphandle kwemvume yakho. Ungasusa idatha yakho nganoma inini. Le nkundla iyahambisana noMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kolwazi Lomuntu (POPIA).
consent.body2: Asithengisi ulwazi lwakho. Asiklabelani nakubani ngaphandle kwemvume yakho. Ungasusa idatha yakho nganoma inini. Le nkundla iyahambisana noMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kolwazi Lomuntu (POPIA).

mood.title: Indlela ozizwa ngayo ngaphakathi
mood.description: Imizwa yakho, umuzwa wakho wokuba nguwe.

body.title: Imisipha, amalunga, isikhumba, namandla
body.description: Indlela umzimba wakho ozwakala ngayo kusuka phandle ukuya phakathi.

mindset.title: Indlela ocabanga nezimizwa ngakho
mindset.description: Imibuzo embalwa yokugcina — ngawe, hhayi izimpawu zakho.

q3.hint: Kusetshenziswa nobude bakho ukubala i-BMI yokudawunilodi yodokotela wakho.

q4.text: Izinkathi zakho ziguquke noma zaphela nini?

q5.text: Ingabe udokotela wake wakhuluma nawe nge-menopause noma amahomoni?

q7.text: Izinkinga zenkumbulo — ukukhohlwa amagama, amagama, noma lapho ubeka khona izinto

q8.text: Ukungatholi amagama — uyakwazi ofuna ukukusho kodwa awulitholi igama

q9.text: Ukunciphisa amandla okwenza imisebenzi eminingi — kunzima ukuphatha okudlula okukodwa kanye

q10.text: Ukuphazama kwemizwa — ukuzizwa uphakeme nophansi ngaphandle kwesizathu

q11.text: Ukucasuka — ukuzwa ulaka noma ukucasuka kalula kunesijwayelekile

q12.text: Ukuzizwa ukhathazekile noma uthukile ngaphezu kokujwayelekile

q13.text: Ukuzizwa uphansi, ulingene nje, noma udangele

q14.text: Ukungabi nesisusa — kunzima ukuthola amandla noma isifiso sokwenza izinto obhihla uzizajzelelisa ngazo

q15.text: Ukungazethembi — ukuzizwa ungenakuzethemba noma uyinto encane kunangaphambili

q16.text: Ukungazwa unjengawe — ukungamboni umuntu obube nguye
q16.hint: Lo mbuzo uthinta abesifazane abaningi okokuqala. Themba lokho okuzwayo.

q17.hint: Ungaphendula ngokweqiniso. Uma uzwa ubunzima, uMandi uzobeka usizo ohlelweni lwakho ngokushesha.

q18.text: Ukushisa kwesiquphe — amagagasi okushisa ngomzimba wakho

q19.text: Ukujuluka ebusuku — ukuvuka umanzi noma ushisa kakhulu

q20.text: Izinkinga zokulala — kunzima ukuwa ebuthongweni noma ukuhlala ulele

q21.text: Ukugxuma kwenhliziyo — inhliziyo yakho egijimayo noma engashayi kahle

q22.text: Amakhanda abuhlungu noma i-migraine — njalo noma kanzima kunangaphambili

q24.text: Imilenze engaphumuli — isifiso esingakhululekile sokushintsha imilenze, ikakhulukazi ebusuku

q26.text: Ubuhlungu emalungeni — ubuhlungu, ukuqina, noma ukuvuvuka emalungeni

q28.text: Ihlombe elingahambi — ubuhlungu noma ukunqunyezelwa kokuhamba ehlombeni
q28.hint: Uphawu lwe-menopause olungaqondwa ngempela. Uma kunjalo, awucabangi.

q29.text: Ukukhathala namandla aphansi — ukhathele ngisho nasemva kokuphumula

q32.text: Izinguquko esikhumbeni — ukuoma, ukuluma, noma ukushintsha kwesithombe

q34.text: Amehlo omile — ukuoma okuqhubekayo, ukucasuka, noma ukubona okufiphele

q35.text: Izinguquko ezinkathini zakho — zinzima, zilula, zide, zifushane, noma azifiki njalo kunangaphambili

q38.text: Izinkinga zesinye — ushisekela, ukuvuza, noma ukuhamba njalo, kuhlanganise nasebusuku

q41.text: Ukunciphisa ukubekezelela utshwala — izingilazi ezimbili ezazingafanele zizwakala njengezine
q41.hint: Lo umbuzo owenza abesifazane bathi: 'mawu — yi-menopause leyo?'

q42.text: Izimpushane ezintsha noma ezimbi kakhulu — i-hay fever, ukungabekezeleli ukudla, noma izimpushane obungazikholwa

q43.text: Ukwenziwa kakhulu kwesimo sempilo esivamile — i-asthma, i-migraine, isimo se-autoimmune, noma okufanayo
q43.hint: Uma kungumpyo onamandla, uMandi uzokuyisa kunakekelo lwezohlobo.

q44.text: Umphumela kwekhono lakho lokusebenza — ukugxila, ukuvelisa, noma ukuzethemba emsebenzini

q46.text: Umphumela kubudlelwane bakho nomndeni — izingane, abazali, izihlobo eziseduze

q47.text: Umphumela kwimpilo yakho yokuhlalisana — ukuhoxa, ukungafuni ukuphuma

q48.text: Umphumela kwekhono lakho lokuhlala uhambisana ne-exercise

q49.text: Uma ucabanga ngalokho obukubhukuda — yini umuzwa wakho?

q50.b: Ngithanda izindlela zemvelo — amakhambi, indlela yokuphila, izenezelelo.

q51.text: Uzizwa kanjani ngohlelo lwezempilo lapho kufika empilweni yakho?
q51.a: Ngithemba udokotela wami — ngidinga nje ukuthunyelwa okufanele.
q51.b: Izimpawu zami ziye zachitha. Ngizizwa ngingabonwa.
q51.c: Ngithanda ukucwaninga kuqala ngaphambi kokuya kudokotela.

q52.text: Uke wazizwa unamahloni noma unesithombe ngalokho okubhukudayo?

q53.text: Uke wazizwa ukuthi mhlawumbe sekuhlangabezele ukuthola usizo — ukuthi uphuthelwe yithuba?

q54.text: Unazo izimo zempilo ezikhona ezikwenza ukhathazeke ngokwelashwa kwamahomoni?
q54.hint: Khetha konke okusebenzayo. Impendulo yakho isiza uMandi akuyise kunakekelo olufanele.

q55.d: Thola udokotela okhuluma ulimi lwami noqonda amahomoni.

q56.hint: Lokhu kusisiza siqonde indlela abesifazane abezwa ngayo ngale nkundla.

questionnaire.blanketCompleteBody: Isitebhe ngasinye yinto oyabelwene nathi. Le ngubo ngeyakho — ingxenye yale eyethungwa ngabo bonke abesifazane baseNingizimu Afrika ndawonye.
questionnaire.resumeBody: Ingubo yakho ilindile — {{progress}} sekuthungiwe. Ungaqhubeka kanye lapho ushiya khona.

facts.context: I-perimenopause — iminyaka yoshintsho ngaphambi kokuthi izinsuku zenyanga ziphele — ivamise ukuthatha iminyaka engaba mi-4 kuya kwengu-8, nakuba kwabanye besifazane imfushane noma inde. I-menopause uqobo lusuku olulodwa nje.
facts.mind-cognition: Inkungu yengqondo iyenye yezimpawu ezivame kakhulu ze-menopause — ibangelwa ukushintsha kwe-oestrogen, hhayi ngokuthi ulahlekelwa ububanzi bakho. Eningini labesifazane, iyaphakama.
facts.mood: Ukushintsha kwemizwa ku-menopause kungokomzimba, akusikho ukwehluleka komuntu. I-oestrogen isebenzisana ne-serotonin, elinye lamakhemikhali emizwa obuchopho — ngakho lapho amazinga ama-hormone eshintsha, imizwa nayo ingashintsha.
facts.nervous-system: Ukushisa kwesiquphe kungaqala iminyaka ngaphambi kwezinkathi zakho zokugcina. Kuya kuma-8 kwabesifazane abali-10 abakubhekana nakho — noma yini oyizwayo, awuwedwa.
facts.body: Ubuhlungu bamalungu nemisipha kuyimpawu enye ye-menopause engaqondwa kahle — i-oestrogen isiza ukugcina amalunga azwakala kahle. Ngisho nehlombe elingahambi kuxhumene nale guquko.
facts.urogenital: Ngokungafani nokushisa kwesiquphe, izimpawu zangaphakathi nezesinye azidlebi kahle ngazo — kodwa ziphendula kahle elashweni. Akukho lutho okufanele uneze namahloni ngalo.
facts.other: Awusakwazi ukubekezelela utshwala njengakuqala? I-oestrogen isebenzisana ne-histamine — ikhemikhali engemuva kokusabela okufana nama-allergy — futhi abanye besifazane baqaphela ukuzwela okusha eminyakeni ephakathi. Awuzicabangeli nje.
facts.quality-of-life: Izimpawu ze-menopause zifika emsebenzini, ekulaleni, nasebudlelwaneni. Ukuqamba lowo mphumela akukhona ukukhala — kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokuthola usekelo olufanele.
facts.mindset: Akukaze kube sekwephuzile ukucela usizo. Ezinye izimpawu — kuhlanganise nezesitho sangasese nezesinye — zisabela kahle ekwelashweni noma sekudlule iminyaka emingaki selokhu kwaba yi-menopause.

roadmap.title: Uhlelo lwakho lweMandi
roadmap.blanketCaption: Isitebhe ngasinye yinto oyabelwene nathi namuhla — indaba yakho, ibanjwe ndawonye.

mild.label: Izimpawu zokuqala
mild.line: Izimpawu zakho zikhona kodwa zingaphathwa. Lesi yisikhathi esihle sokwazi nokuthatha izinyathelo ezimnene.

moderate.label: Ushintsho lwehomoni oluqhubekayo
moderate.line: Izimpawu zakho zithinta impilo yakho yansuku zonke. Uyafanelekile ukuthola usekelo olufanele — hhayi ukuxoshelwa ukuqhubeka nje.

significant.label: Umphumela omkhulu
significant.line: Izimpawu zakho zinomphumela obalulekile empilweni yakho yansuku zonke. Uyafanele usekelo manje — futhi ungalithola.

sally.headline: Ubufuna. Nazi izimpendulo zakho.
sally.body: Lokho okuzwayo kuyiqiniso. Kunigama. Futhi kunousizo otholakalayo — okuqala namuhla.

olga.headline: Kungahle kube nesikhulu ngaphezu kokucabanga kwakho.
olga.body: Eziningi zezinto obuzicabangela ukucindezeleka noma ukuguga ziyimpawu eziqondwayo zoshintsho lwamahomoni.

vicky.headline: Uyafanele ukuzwiwa — nokusizwa.
vicky.body: Uma uchithwe ngaphambili, lokho kwakungafanele. UMandi uzohamba nawe ukuya kunakekelo olufanele.

nelly.headline: Wazi okuningi. Nazi okushiwo ubufakazi obutsha.
nelly.body: Ucwaningo lwakho lukukhonzile kahle. UMandi uzoqinisekisa ukuthi ingxoxo yakho elandelayo iyaziswe ngokupheleleyo.

nina.headline: Imizwa yakho ngomzimba wakho ikhona.
nina.body: Kunendawo yendlela yokuphila nendawo yemithi. Uhlelo lwakho lwehlonipha kokubili, ndawonye.

retha.headline: Akukho lubende ukuzwakala kangcono.
retha.body: Ubufakazi mayelana nokungenelela kwakamuva luncomekile kakhulu kunalokho ongahle ukuzwe. Zikhona izindlela ezifanele ukubhekiswa.

colleen.headline: Isimo sakho sifanele ukufakwa kwezehlobo.
colleen.body: Ngomlando ofanayo, ukunakekelwa okufanele kusho udokotela ofanele — oqonda zombili izimo zakho namahomoni akho.

selfHarm.title: Lokho okwabelene nathi kufanele isibindi.
selfHarm.body: Awuwedwa kulokhu — futhi akudingi ubhekane nakho wedwa. Sicela uxhumane. ISouth African Depression and Anxiety Group itholakala usuku lonke, isonto lonke.

colleen.title: Kunconywa ukunakekelwa okuhlobile.
colleen.body: Ngenxa yomlando wakho wezempilo, uhlelo lwakho lubeka phambili ukukuhlanganisa nesisebenzi esikwazi ukuphatha impilo yakho yamahomoni kanye nezimo zakho ezikhona. Iseluleko se-HRT esivamile silandelayo lapha — ukuphepha kwakho kuqala.

book-first.title: Bhuka isikhathi sokucebisana
book-first.body: Ngokususelwa kulokho okwabelene nathi, ukukhuluma nedokotela ofunde nge-HRT yisinyathelo esibaluleke kakhulu esilandelayo. Thola lo okhuluma ulimi lwakho oqonda amahomoni.

education-first.title: Qonda okwenzekayo
education-first.body: Qala ngokuyisisekelo — indlela ukushintsha kwamahomoni okubonakala ngayo, nokuthi izimpawu zakho zinengqondo.

normalise-first.title: Awuwedwa kulokhu
normalise-first.body: Zwa kwabanye abesifazane baseNingizimu Afrika ababekhona kahle lapho ukhona — futhi bathola indlela yokuphuma.

options-first.title: Yazi izindlela zakho
options-first.body: I-HRT efana nomzimba, izindlela zempilo, ukunakekelwa okuhlanganisiwe — qonda okutholakalayo nokushiwo ubufakazi.

clinic-first.title: Thola usizo eduze nawe
clinic-first.body: Sesha kwincwadi yethu yokukhokela yabasebenzi abafanele i-HRT — okuhlukaniswe ngolimi lwakho nendawo, kuhlanganise i-telemedicine.

download-first.title: Kuthathe uye kudokotela wakho
download-first.body: Dawunilodi isifinyezo sephepha elilodwa sephrofayela yakho yezimpawu, iMenoScore, nemibuzo yokubuza — idokhumenti eshintsha ingxoxo yakho.

feedback.title: Lolu hlelo lulungile kuwe?
feedback.thanks: Siyabonga — kusisiza ukwakha okungcono komunye wesifazane ozofika.

login.title: Wamukelekile futhi.
login.subtitle: Ngena ukubona uhlelo lwakho, irekhodi lezimpawu, nokuzihlangana.

signup.title: Joyina iMandi.
signup.subtitle: Gcina uhlelo lwakho, landela izimpawu zakho, futhi ubone indlela oguqulayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

error.invalidLogin: Leyo imeyili negama lokungena akuhambisani. Zama futhi.

name.heading: UMandi uyintambo evamile edabula kithi sonke.
name.p1: NgesiBhunu, sisifushane sika-Amanda. NgesiXhosa, sicholwe kuMandisa. Izilimi ezahlukene, imiphakathi ehlukene, izinhlangenwa zempilo ezihlukene — kanti nathi sikhona lapha, abesifazane abafanayo, sihamba imizimba efanayo, sifanelekile ukunakekelwa okufanayo.
name.p2: Sakhetha igama eliqala ngo-M ukubeka le phrojekthi ku-Menopause — isigaba sempilo esivuse lo mthwalo. Kodwa uMandi wahlala ehlosiwe ukukhula ngaphandle kwesahluko sokuqala. Ngoba impilo yamahomoni ayiqali ipheli nge-menopause. Uhambo lwempilo yonke, futhi umuntu wesifazane ngamunye ufanelekile umngani othembekile kulo lonke.

story.heading: Le nkundla yazalwa endabeni yobuqu.
story.p1: Eminyakeni yami yokugcina engama-40, ngakhuluma ngokugxuma kwenhliziyo nabasebenzi bami ababili abadala emini. Omunye ngokushesha wancomela ukuthi ngibone uchwepheshe wenhliziyo. Omunye wathi yingxenye nje yokuguga. Akekho owakhuluma nge-menopause. Akekho owathi ukugxuma kwenhliziyo yingxenye yezimpawu eziphezu kwe-100 eziqondwayo zoshintsho lwamahomoni. Bengingenanto.
story.p2: Ngemuva kwesikhathi ngathuthela eKapa eneminyaka engama-50, ngilungele izinhlangano ezintsha ezimnandi. Esikhundleni salokho, ngagcina esibhedlela ngomkhuhlane omkhulu wezinso obangelwe yi-bladder infection. Ngabona udokotela wezesinye. UGP wami. Udokotela wabesifazane. Akekho oyedwa kubo owabuza ukuthi ngise-HRT yini. Akekho oyedwa owahlanganisa izifo zami eziphindelelayo namahomoni ami — noma ukuxhumana kuyaziwa kahle. Belingelapha izimpawu zami, hhayi imbangela.
story.p3: Ngabhekana iminyaka nobuhlungu bamalunga, inkungu yengqondo, izinguquko zemizwa, ama-UTI, ucansi olubuhlungu, ukushisa kwesiquphe, amehlo omile, nezimpawu eziningi.
story.p4: Ngabe-ke ngangena ku-inthanethi. Ngathola uDr Louise Newson. UDr Mary Claire Haver. UDr Lisa Mosconi. Nabaningi. Ngaqala ukutshela bonke abangani bami ukuthola usizo. Umyeni wami uthi ngiyi-menopause evangelist.
story.p5: Lokhu kungiqhubile ukuthi ngithulele ikykNET uchungechunge lwedokhumentari olubizwa nge-Meer As Warm Gloede — uchungechunge lwezindawo ezine oluqala ngo-Agasti 2026. Lwephula ukuthula ngokuzungeza i-menopause emiphakathini ekhuluma isiBhunu, lukhuluma izindaba zoqobo zabesifazane bokwenene, futhi linika ababukeli ulwazi nesibindi sokuthatha impilo yabo ezandleni zabo.
story.p6: Idokhumentari yavula iminyango. Ucwaningo olwengeziwe lwangihola ukuthola iMIDI eUnited States — inkundla esithole isimo se-unicorn maduzane, isebenzela amakhulu ezinkulungwane zabesifazane kuyo yonke iminyaka eyi-50. Lokho kuqonda kwabeka into iqala.
story.p7: Manje sengiqala lolu hambo nabanye abesifazane abamangalisayo ukwakha okwethu kweNingizimu Afrika: JoinMandi.com.

vision.heading: I-JoinMandi.com ingaphezu kwewebhusayithi. Ingumzabalazo.
vision.p1: Yinkolelo yokuthi wonke umuntu wesifazane waseNingizimu Afrika — eParow noma ePolokwane, eSoweto noma eStellenbosch, noma akhuluma isiBhunu, isiZulu, isiXhosa, noma noma yiziphi ezinye izilimi ezenza leli lizwe libe ngelimangalisayo — kufanele aqonde okwenzekayo emzimbeni wakhe, ngolimi oluzwakala lulekhaya.
vision.p2: INingizimu Afrika inezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Iningi lezinkundla zempilo zedijithali zisebenzisa olulodwa: isiNgisi. Lokho akukho ngokwanele. UMandi wakhiwe ukukhula nezwe — emphakathini ngamunye lapho abesifazane bashiywe ngaphandle kwezimpendulo eziqondwayo nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okufanele.

alone.headline: Akekho owesifazane okufanele azizwe eyedwa, engenalwazi, noma engesekelwe phakathi nokuphela kwe-menopause nangaphesheya.

blanket.body: Isikhokelo esikhulu sika-Mandi yingubo — ingubo eyenziwe ngezindwangu ezahlukene, izinhlanganisela ezahlukene, amasiko ahlukene, athungelwe ndawonye ukuba into ephelele, efudumele, futhi enhle. NjengoMandi. NjengeNingizimu Afrika.

resources.title: Ulwazi ongaluthemba.
resources.subhead: Konke lapha kususelwe kubufakazi, kuhloliwe ngokunemba, futhi kubhalwe ngolimi olulula. Akukho jargon. Akukho ukwahlulela. Akukho ukuthengisa.
resources.intro: Konke lapha kususelwe kubufakazi, kuhloliwe ngokunemba, futhi kubhalwe ngolimi olulula. Akukho jargon. Akukho ukwahlulela. Akukho ukukuthengisela okuthize. Yi-information nje ofanele ube nayo.

perimenopause.title: Yini i-perimenopause?
perimenopause.description: Isingeniso esicacile, esekelwe ebufakazini eminyakeni ngaphambi kwe-menopause — okwenzekayo emzimbeni wakho nokuthi kungani kubalulekile.

symptoms.title: Izimpawu ezingaphezu kwe-100 zoshintsho lwamahomoni
symptoms.description: Ukugxuma kwenhliziyo. Ubuhlungu bamalunga. Inkungu yengqondo. Amehlo omile. Lo mhlahlandlela ufihla isithombe esiphelele — ukuze kungaphazwa lutho.

bodyIdentical.title: I-HRT efana nomzimba ichaziwe
bodyIdentical.description: Yini amahomoni afana nomzimba, ahluka njani nezindlela zakuqala ze-synthetic, nokuthi kushwoni ubufakazi bamanje.

routes.title: Izindlela zokufaka i-HRT
routes.description: Iziqephu, amagels, amaphilisi, amaspray, ukulungiselelwa kwesithako — umhlahlandlela olula wezindlela zakho.

mood.title: Amahomoni nemizwa yakho
mood.description: Ukukhathazeka, imizwa ephansi, nentukuthelo evela kungekho ndawo. Qonda ukuxhumana kwamahomoni — nokusiza.

nutrition.title: Ukudla ngezempilo yamahomoni
nutrition.description: Isikhokelo sokudla esisebenzayo ku-perimenopause nangaphesheya — okushiwo yiqiniso ngokudla namahomoni.

whi.title: Ucwaningo lwe-WHI — okwenzeka ngempela
whi.description: Ucwaningo lwango-2002 olushintshe yonke into — nokuthi kungani iziphetho zichazwe kabi. Isifinyezo esisesilula.

brain.title: I-Oestrogen nempilo yengqondo
brain.description: Ucwaningo olusha lwendima ye-oestrogen ekusebenzeni kwengqondo nokubaluleka 'kwesikhathi esibalulekile' sokwelashwa.

resources.notice1: Izinsiza ezengeziwe zongezelelwa njalo. Konke okuqukethwe kuhlolwa umlingani wezempilo uDr Funeka Bango ngaphambi kokushicilelwa.
resources.notice2: Izinsiza zesiZulu nesiXhosa ziyathuthukiswa. Uma ungasiza ngokuhumusha, sithinte.

events.title: Imicimbi yaMandi
events.subhead: Lapho umphakathi weJoinMandi uba ngowoqobo. I-menopause yayiyimfihlo — lapha iba yomphakathi.

screening.title: Meer as Warm Gloede — Umboniso Womphakathi
screening.description: Idokhumentari yekykNET kwiskrini esikhulu. Imibukiso yomphakathi ilandelwa yingxoxo eqondiswayo — endaweni eseduze nawe.

askspecialist.title: Buza Uchwepheshe we-Menopause — Bukhona Ku-inthanethi
askspecialist.description: I-Q&A ephilayo nedokotela ohlanganisayo. Letha imibuzo yakho nge-HRT, amahomoni afana nomzimba, nezinyathelo ezisebenzayo ezilandelayo.

cafe.title: IMandi Café — I-Menopause Phezu Kwekofi
cafe.description: Akukho jelo, akukho ukucindezeleka. Abesifazane nje bekhuluma ngokweqiniso ngemizimba yabo phezu kwekofi. Ngena nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.

isizulu.title: Impilo Yamahomoni ngesiZulu
isizulu.description: Ingxoxo yempilo yomphakathi yabesifazane baseKZN, ngesiZulu, ehlanganisa izisekelo ze-perimenopause ne-menopause.

host.heading: Hlela umcimbi kuMandi.
host.body: Noma uyidokotela wabesifazane owenza i-Q&A yanyanga ngayinye, i-NGO ehlela imorningi yomphakathi, noma indawo yokusebenza esekela abasebenzi bakho — imicimbi yaMandi yiplatfomu yakho futhi. Mahhala ukufaka.

principle.line: Umphakathi uhlala umahhala. Ubungoti bungaba nentela.

doctor.title: Ukunakekelwa okukhuluma ulimi lwakho.
doctor.subhead: Abasebenzi abafundisiwe nge-HRT kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika — abomtholampilo, abomphakathi, naba ku-inthanethi. Hlukanisa ngesifundazwe, ulimi, nefomethi.
doctor.empty: Akukho mitholampilo etholakele ngokukhetha kwakho. Ezengeziwe zongezelelwa njalo.

newson.note: Uchwepheshe we-HRT. Ukwelashwa kwamahomoni afana nomzimba.

hormonal.note: Uchwepheshe we-menopause. Izixhumano ku-inthanethi nabuso nobuso.

community.note: Ukunakekelwa kwamahhala noma okuxhasiwe. Indlela yokuthunyelwa iyatholakala.

bango.blurb: Umeluleki wezempilo eJoinMandi. Umsebenzi ofudumele, oqonda ubufakazi, ogxile empilweni yamahomoni yabesifazane base-Afrika.

vandyk.blurb: GP ofundisiwe nge-HRT osebenza eStellenbosch. Uchwepheshe we-HRT efana nomzimba ene-telehealth kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika.

hrt.title: Iqiniso Nge-HRT
hrt.subhead: Ukwesaba kuhambe umhlaba ngamahora angama-24 ngo-2002. Ukulungiswa kuthathe iminyaka engama-23. Naku okufanele wonke umuntu wesifazane akwazi — ngesiNgisi esilula.

compare.heading: I-Synthetic kanye nefana nomzimba
compare.intro: Into ebaluleke kakhulu abesifazane abangayazi ukuthi akusilo lonke i-HRT lifana. Lo mehluko uyisihluthu sayo yonke into elandelayo.

synthetic.label: I-HRT esynthetic / engesilo elabantu
synthetic.name: Premarin · Provera
synthetic.body: I-Premarin — eyenziwe ngomchamo wamahhashi — iqukethe ama-estrogens umzimba womuntu ongasenzelwe ngokwemvelo. I-Provera (MPA) — i-progestin esynthetic. Akusiyo i-molecule efana ne-progesterone yomuntu.
synthetic.note: Yilona lolu olwacwanyangwa ucwaningo lwe-WHI lwango-2002.

bodyIdentical.label: I-HRT efana nomzimba
bodyIdentical.name: Estradiol · Micronised Progesterone
bodyIdentical.body: I-Estradiol (17β-estradiol) — eyenziwe ezitshalweni. Iyafana ngokwekhemikhali ne-oestrogen yomuntu. I-Micronised progesterone (Prometrium / Utrogestan) — iyafana ne-progesterone yomuntu.

timeline.heading: 1992 — Namuhla
timeline.intro: Iresha yalokho okwenzeka ngempela — nokushintshayo manje.

t1992.headline: I-Premarin ifika engqungqutheleni.
t1992.body: I-Premarin — eyenziwe ngomchamo wamahhashi anethumbu — iba ngumuthi obhalelwe kakhulu eMelika. Ucwaningo lwe-WHI luqala, luhlola iPremarin neProvera kubesifazane abayizi-160,000.

t2002.headline: Ucwaningo olwashintsha konke — ngezizathu ezingalungile.
t2002.body: Uhlolo lwe-WHI luyamiswa kusenesikhathi. Izihloko zomhlaba zithi i-HRT ibangela umdlavuza wamabele. Ukusebenzisa kwehla ngama-80%. Ingozi yobuqu — izehlakalo ezi-4 kubesifazane abayi-1,000 ngeminyaka emihlanu — ayikhulunyiswa njalo. Imiphumela isetshenziswa kuyo yonke i-HRT, kuhlanganise amahomoni afana nomzimba angazange ahlolisiswe.

t2003.headline: Izixwayiso ezimnyama zifakwa.
t2003.body: I-FDA isebenzisa izixwayiso zekilasi lonke kuwo wonke amaphilisi e-HRT — kuhlanganise amahomoni afana nomzimba angenabo ubufakazi obunjalo bomonakalo. Isizukulwane sabesifazane sicashiselwe ukwelashwa ngokususelwa kuziphumo ezingasebenzi kubo.

t2008.headline: Isifumaniso esibalulekile saseFrance.
t2008.body: Ucwaningo lwe-E3N luthola ukuthi i-progesterone efana nomzimba ayikhuphuli ingozi yomdlavuza wamabele — ngokungafani ne-progestin esynthetic eyasetshenziswa kwi-WHI. Inkinga ngo-2002 yayingeyona i-oestrogen — yayiyi-synthetic ethile eyasetshenziswa.

t2013.headline: I-Oestrogen yodwa inciphisa ingozi yomdlavuza wamabele.
t2013.body: Ishumi leminyaka yokulandela kwe-WHI luqinisekisa ukuthi i-HRT ye-estrogen-kuphela inciphisa kakhulu izigameko zomdlavuza wamabele nokufa. Lokhu kuphikisa ngqo umyalezo wango-2002 — kodwa kuthatha iminyaka eyishumi ukufika kuwo wonke umphakathi.

t2015.headline: I-NICE yase-UK iyincoma i-HRT efana nomzimba.
t2015.body: I-HRT efana nomzimba — iziqephu ze-estradiol noma igel kanye ne-progesterone emicronised — iba yindlela enconywayo. Iziphakamiso ze-HRT eNgilandi ziqala ukuphakama kusukela kuleli phuzu.

t2025.headline: I-FDA isusa izixwayiso.
t2025.body: I-HHS yaseMelika ne-FDA bamemezela ukususwa kwezixwayiso ezibanzi ezimnyama. I-FDA ithi: abesifazane abaqala i-HRT eminyakeni eyi-10 ngemuva kwe-menopause bangaba kunciphise ingozi yenhliziyo ukuya kuma-50%, ingozi ye-Alzheimer ngama-35%, nengozi yokuphuka kwamathambo ngama-50–60%.

t2026.headline: Meer as Warm Gloede iyadlala. I-JoinMandi.com iyaqaliswa.
t2026.body: Wonke umuntu wesifazane waseNingizimu Afrika ufanelekile lo mlando — ngolimi lwakhe.

sources.heading: Imithombo
sources.disclaimer: Ulwazi lwemfundo kuphela — hhayi iseluleko sezempilo. Xoxa ngezimo zakho zomuntu siqu nomhlanganisi wezempilo onesifundazwe.

cta.heading: Kusala kuphi lokhu?
cta.body: Ufanelekile izimpendulo ezineqiniso ngolimi lwakho zivela kubasebenzi abaqonda impilo yamahomoni.

mothers.title: Hlonipha Omama
mothers.subhead: Indawo yokokoba yeMandi. Ukuhlonipha okuthuleyo, okuzimiseleyo, kobuntu obudidekile ukuthi inkundla abesifazane abayisebenzisa namuhla ime esisekelweni esingahlonipanga njalo imizimba, amazwi, noma ukukhetha kwabesifazane.

baartman.body: Owayengowesifazane waseKhoikhoi owathathwa eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1810 wabukiswa eYurophu njengomboniso womphakathi. Wafa eParis ngo-1815, eneminyaka engama-26. Umzimba wakhe wahlala uboniswa eFrance kwaze kwaba ngu-1974. UNelson Mandela wacela ngokusemthethweni ukubuyiselwa kwakhe ngo-1994. Ngomhla ka-9 Agasti 2002 — Usuku Lukazwelonke Lwabesifazane — ekugcineni wangcwatshwa eduze nendawo yokuzalwa kwakhe. Wabuya ekhaya. Ungowethu sonke.

anarcha.body: Abesifazane abathathu abamnyama abagqilelweyo amagama abo siyawazi. Phakathi kuka-1845 no-1849 babhanjwa kunyongulwa ngokuvavanyo — uAnarcha wenze okungenani izinyongulwa eziyi-30 ngaphandle kwe-anaesthesia — njengoba isisekelo segynaecology yesimanje sakhiwa phezu kwezinhlungu zabo. Ngo-2021, isikhumbuzo se-15-feet sakhiwa ngokuhlonipha kwabo. Amagama abo akhulunywa namuhla.

finding.heading: Abesifazane esisengabathola.
finding.body: Imizimba yabesifazane base-Afrika ibe izindawo zocwaningo lwezempilo, ukuvavanyo kweminyaka yobukoloniyali, nokunganakwa kwesistim phakathi nezinkulungwane ezehlukene zezwekazi. Izindaba ezithile zisathokozelwa. Njengoba sizithola, sizozonezela lapha. Uma wazi indaba ekufanele ibe kuleli khasi, sifuna ukuyizwa.

wall.heading: Uke wachithwa? Awuwedwa.
wall.intro: Izindaba ezimfushane ezisetshenziswa ngabasebenzisi beMandi. Imisho emithathu noma ngaphansi. Akakhethwa uma befuna. Ndawonye baba into enamandla.
wall.thandi: Iminyaka emithathu bengicabanga ukuthi ngilahlekelwa yingqondo. Udokotela wami uthi ngiyikhathaze. Akekho omunye owayethi i-menopause.
wall.mariette: Ek het vyf jaar simptome gehad en nie geweet nie. Ek was nie besig om gek te word nie — my hormoon het verander.
wall.nomsa: Umama wami akakaze akhulume ngalokhu. Umama wakhe akakaze akhulume ngakho. Ngifuna indodakazi yami ibe nalo lonke olunye uhambo.

closing.names: Sarah Baartman. Anarcha. Betsey. Lucy. Nawo wonke owesifazane igama lakhe alikaze libhalwe phansi.
closing.body: Imizimba yabo yathwala umthwalo we-sayensi eyayingakaqondi ukubaphatha njengabantu. UMandi wakhiwa ngokuhlonipha kubo. Leli khasi liyoqhubeka likhula — ngoba kunamagama amaningi okufanele atholwe, nabesifazane abaningi okufanele bezwiwe.

founder.quote: Le nkundla yazalwa endabeni yami — iminyaka yezimpawu lapho akekho owayexhumanise namahomoni ami. Uma usuwazi kangcono, ungakwenza kangcono. Futhi ungasiza abanye benze okufanayo.

journey.intro: Lapha lapho uMandi ekhumbula okubaluleke kuwe.

roadmap.emptyBody: Chitha imizuzu eyishumi noMandi futhi uthole uhlelo lobuqu — izindatshana, izinsiza, nesifinyezo esilungele udokotela esenzelwe wena.

tracker.title: Indlela obukhona ngayo kuleli sonto.
tracker.intro: Thepha idot ukugcina iqophelo (0 = akukho, 3 = ngokweqile).

checkins.title: Indlela uhambo lwakho oluhamba ngayo.
checkins.intro: Izikhathi ezimbili ezimnene zokubuyela emuva — nokubheka phambili.
checkins.threeMonthSub: Ukubuyekezwa okuphelele. Kufana nesibonelo se-NHS / NICE.

footer.privacy: Ubumfihlo bakho — indlela esisebenzisa idatha yakho

mode.title: Ungathanda ukuphendula kanjani?
mode.tapsSub: Umbuzo owodwa ngesikhathi — ngaphansi kwemizuzu emibili

capture.marketing: Yebo, uMandi angangithinta mayelana nokuhlolwa kwami okuphelele, imicimbi nokwesekwa. Ngingasho noma nini ukuthi angabe esangithinta.
capture.finePrint: Asisoze sabelane ngemininingwane yakho. Ungacela ukuthi sisule konke noma nini.

chat.greeting: Sawubona, nginguMandi. Nginemibuzo eyisishiyagalombili esheshayo mayelana nokuthi uzizwa kanjani muva nje — vele uthephe impendulo efanele.

hi.1: Lowo muzwa wokulahlekelwa amagama — akusiyo ingqondo yakho ekwehlulayo.
hi.2: Inkumbulo yakho ayiphukile. Abesifazane abaningi kakhulu bachaza khona lokhu.

hi.1: Ubuthongo yilapho kuqala khona kwabaningi besifazane. Awuwedwa.
hi.2: Umzimba wakho ukugcina uphapheme ebusuku. Lokho kubalulekile.

hi.1: Umzimba wakho ukutshela okuthile — futhi kufanele ukulalele.
Yebo — leyo imangaza cishe wonke umuntu.
hi.2: Abesifazane abaningi bakwenza lokho kuxhumana kamuva kakhulu.

hi.1: Yilapho izimpawu zifinyelela khona empilweni yakho. Kubaluleke kakhulu.

story.disclaimer: Ulwazi lwemfundo kuphela — akusiyo iseluleko sezokwelapha.

intro.title: Ingubo yakho ixoxa indaba
intro.sub: Skrolela phansi — yonke ingcephe oyithungile inokuthile ezokusho.

cute.mind-cognition: Amagama alahlekayo phakathi komusho? Awalahlekile — asekhefini letiye nje.
cute.urogenital: Izinto okungakhulunywa ngazo — thina sikhuluma ngazo.
cute.mindset: Ufikile. Lowo ngumthungo omkhulu kunayo yonke.

hormoneHook.title: Ungawashiyi ngaphandle ama-hormone akho.
hormoneHook.body: Abesifazane abaningi kakhulu baphila iminyaka nezimpawu ezifana nalezi — bengazi ukuthi ama-hormone angaba yingxenye yendaba. Noma ngabe ingubo yakho ibukeka kanjani, kufanele uwaqonde. Yilokho uMandi akwakhayo: impilo yabesifazane ehlosiwe, engenakuhlazisa, ngolimi lwakho, ngezwi lase-Afrika.

none.title: Ingubo yakho ibukeka izolile — unenhlanhla!
none.body: Azikho izimpawu ezinamandla namuhla. I-menopause ifika ngokwehlukile kuwo wonke owesifazane — futhi ukwazi okufanele ukubheke kuyisiqalo esihle kunazo zonke.

consent.title: Ukunambitha okusheshayo kukaMandi
consent.body: Imibuzo eyisishiyagalombili emnene, ngaphansi kwemizuzu emibili. Akukho okugcinwayo ngaphandle kokuthi ukhethe ukushiya i-imeyili yakho ekugcineni.

band.mild: Izimpawu zakho zibukeka zilula — ukuhlala unolwazi kuyisinyathelo esilandelayo esihle kakhulu.
band.moderate: Izimpawu zakho zibukeka ziphakathi — awuzicabangeli nje, futhi awuwedwa.
band.significant: Izimpawu zakho zibukeka zinzima — udokotela oqonda i-menopause angashintsha konke.

email.title: Hamba nengubo yakho
email.body: Shiya i-imeyili yakho uMandi uzokuthumelela imiphumela yakho — futhi akwamukele ohambweni ngesikhathi esiqala ngaso.
email.consent: Gcina i-imeyili yami nezimpendulo zedemo ukuze uMandi angithumelele imiphumela yami nezindaba zokwethulwa.

thanks.title: Sala kahle, okwamanje.
thanks.bodyKiosk: Siyabonga ngokuthunga nathi — sicela ubuyisele ithebulethi.
thanks.bodyPhone: Bheka ibhokisi lakho le-imeyili. Ingubo yakho ephelele — nombutho wempilo yabesifazane onezwi lase-Afrika — ukulindile ku-joinmandi.com.
